title: Lax monoidal functors into cartesian targets as product-cone functors
statement:
Use the infinity-category and universe conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid]. Use the cocartesian fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $r:\mathcal C^{\otimes}\to N(\mathsf{Fin}_*)$ be a symmetric monoidal infinity category: a cocartesian fibration whose fiber over $\langle n\rangle=\{*,1,\ldots,n\}$ is $\mathcal C^n$ via the inert projections $\rho_i:\langle n\rangle\to\langle1\rangle$; inert means every non-basepoint of the target has exactly one preimage. Let $\mathcal D$ be an infinity category with finite products and let $\mathcal D^{\times}$ be its cartesian symmetric monoidal infinity category of [lem-coef-cartesian-operadic-envelope]. A lax symmetric monoidal functor to $\mathcal D^{\times}$ means a functor $H:\mathcal C^{\otimes}\to\mathcal D^{\times}$ over $N(\mathsf{Fin}_*)$ preserving cocartesian arrows over inert maps. Such functors are equivalently functors $F:\mathcal C^{\otimes}\to\mathcal D$ for which, for every tuple $c=(c_i)_{i=1}^n$, the arrows $F(c)\to F(c_i)$ induced by the inert cocartesian projections exhibit $F(c)$ as $\prod_iF(c_i)$, including $F(())$ terminal for $n=0$. In this correspondence $H$ has underlying functor $F|_{\mathcal C}$, and its $n$-ary comparison is
$$\prod_iF(c_i)\simeq F((c_i))\xrightarrow{F(\mu)}F\left(\bigotimes_i c_i\right),$$
where $\mu$ is a cocartesian lift in $\mathcal C^{\otimes}$ of the fold map $\langle n\rangle\to\langle1\rangle$. The correspondence includes natural transformations and all higher homotopies. For a fixed $F$ with its product-cone property, the space of lifts $H$ equipped with this identification is contractible.
